rb-ai-team-tools.description: Project-local MCP server exposing the rb-ai-team tools (run_tests, git_commit, deploy_preview, db_migrate, deploy_production) with permission-tier enforcement. Tier-3 tools require SPEC.md tier_defaults.allow_tier3=true.

trello-tools.description: Trello MCP: list boards/lists/cards, sync a list's cards + download the uploaded prints to .trello-cache/ (git-ignored), read card comments (read, Tier 1), and comment/move/create cards and add labels by name (write-back, Tier 2). Never Tier 3. Reads TRELLO_API_KEY/TRELLO_TOKEN from the gitignored root .env; without them the server starts and each call says what is missing.
